ideas.title: The Impact of Medicaid Fraud on Minnesota's Budget Surplus
ideas.description: Investigate how Medicaid fraud affects Minnesota's $3.7B budget surplus and the state's ability to fund essential services
questions: How much does Medicaid fraud cost Minnesota?
What services are most affected by fraud?
searches: Minnesota Medicaid fraud impact on budget
ideas.insight: Understanding the financial impact of Medicaid fraud on Minnesota's budget is crucial for informing policy decisions and ensuring the sustainability of essential services.

ideas.title: Uncovering Patterns in Autism Services Fraud
ideas.description: Analyze the patterns and commonalities in autism services fraud cases in Minnesota to identify potential vulnerabilities and areas for improvement
questions: What are the most common types of autism services fraud?
How can data analysis help prevent future fraud?
ideas.insight: By examining patterns in autism services fraud, investigators can develop targeted strategies to prevent future instances and protect vulnerable populations.
